title: The Little Astronaut and the Moon Rover Rescue
summary: A little astronaut blasts off in her orange rocket to rescue her robot friend Pebble from a dusty moon crater, and when pushing and pulling don't work, she thinks like an engineer, cleans his solar panels, builds a ramp and brings him back to the top.
style: gouache storybook painting (opaque matte gouache with soft visible brushstrokes and paper grain, simple bold shapes, hand-painted classic picture-book look in a palette of deep indigo night, teal, warm tangerine orange, soft cream and silver-gray; not CGI, not watercolor, not comic)

title: Damian and the Halloween Lights
summary: On Halloween night, Damian, in the superhero cape and cardboard rocket-pack he engineered himself, leads his costumed friends along a dark wire to find why the pumpkin lights went out, gently frees a tangled kitten and lights up Lantern Lane again.
style: bright comic-book style (bold black ink outlines, Ben-Day halftone dot shading, flat vivid colors in a warm night palette of deep blue, pumpkin orange, golden yellow and red, friendly classic children's comic look; a single full-page illustration, no panels, no speech bubbles)

title: The Little Raccoon and Baby's First Halloween
summary: On Baby's very first Halloween, a little raccoon big brother in a firefighter costume guides the way door to door, remembering please and thank you, waiting patiently, taking turns and sharing a treat Baby can eat, then heads home proud, loved and sleepy.
style: bold flat mid-century graphic (1950s-60s modern picture-book look: simple geometric shapes, flat bold colors in a limited palette of tangerine orange, teal, mustard yellow, cream, red and deep navy, crisp clean edges, subtle dry-brush and halftone print texture; no gradients, no shading, not CGI, not watercolor)

title: The Pumpkin Express and the Great Big Pumpkin
summary: On Halloween night, a little red panda drives his pumpkin train toward the party on Candy Hill, and when a giant pumpkin blocks the track, he and his costumed friends build a clever ramp and give it a ride.

title: Night Wings: The True Story of a Little Brown Bat
summary: In this true story, a tiny little brown bat wakes at dusk, flies on wings that are really hands, finds moths in the dark with echoes, and snuggles into a quiet cave to hibernate for the winter.
style: detailed realistic colored pencil and crayon (natural-history field-guide feel, fine layered pencil strokes and soft waxy crayon texture on warm cream paper)

title: The Little Dragon and the Sparkly Sneeze
summary: A little orange dragon worries that his sneezes puff sparks, until a gusty Halloween wind blows out every jack-o'-lantern and his gentle sparks light the way for everyone.
style: chunky clay stop-motion animation, handmade plasticine models with visible fingerprints and soft rounded shapes, miniature handcrafted sets, warm practical lighting

title: The Tortoise, the Hare and the Harvest Race
summary: A speedy hare and a steady little tortoise race to the biggest pumpkin on the hill one autumn evening, and everyone learns that slow and steady wins the race.

title: Rumble and the Brand-New Baby
summary: A little blue dragon can't wait to show his brand-new baby sister his biggest flying tricks, and learns that being gentle, patient and helpful is the best big-brother trick of all.

title: Damian and the Great Crab Haul
summary: Damian, the youngest deckhand on a sturdy crab boat far up north, helps haul the big crab pots, figures out why the winch got stuck, sets the little crabs free, and is rocked to sleep under the northern lights.

title: From Tiny Seed to Jack-o'-Lantern
summary: A true story of how a pumpkin grows, from one tiny seed in spring to a long curly vine, yellow flowers, busy bees, a green pumpkin turning orange, and a cozy glowing jack-o'-lantern on the porch.

title: Pip the Little Glow Ghost
summary: A friendly little ghost who glows like a pumpkin lantern wants to join the Harvest Moon Party, and when the lanterns blow out, his kind glow shows everyone that looking different is a wonderful thing.

title: Ollie Otter and the Moon's Hiccups
summary: When the moon gets the hiccups and can't fall asleep, a little otter and his friends try every silly trick until a gentle lullaby and a hug do the job.
